🚨 TRAFFIC ADVISORY FOR SWFL MOTORISTS 🚨 

If you plan on traveling in or around Collier Co. and the surrounding regions, please be sure to closely monitor travel conditions for potential wildfire impacts. While FDOT is closely monitoring roadways, conditions can change quickly and unexpectedly. Be sure to plan ahead or make alternative travel options and check https://t.co/x4kyn4cx6L for real-time traffic conditions and road closure updates.

TRAFFIC ADVISORY
5:25 p.m. Wednesday February 25 2026
PEI RCMP are on scene at the Slemon Park Roundabout where a tractor trailer has become stuck. Please avoid the area or follow all detours instructions.
Updates on PEI RCMP social media. https://t.co/DjSME7J32D
